summary: The visible suite now passes (3/3). The only file I changed is `solution/core.py`. The cause was that the binary-operator and `SWAP` handlers popped operands in reverse. For `SUB`, `LT`, `GT`, `DIV`, and `MOD`, `a` was the right operand and `b` the left, so `1 2 LT` gave 0 and `5 1 SUB`-style loops ran backwards. That is why the countdown loop never terminated and hit the step limit. `DIV` and `MOD` checked the wrong operand for zero, so `1 0 DIV` never raised. `SWAP` popped in the same reversed order and pushed back the same values, making it a no-op. I changed the operator pop to `b, a = pop(), pop()` so `a` is the left operand, and changed `SWAP` to `a, b = pop(), pop()` so it actually swaps. I did not touch `tests/`, the public API, or any other files. I also spot-checked `SWAP`, `SUB`, `MOD`, and `DIV` with inline commands, and the results are as expected.
